name: Dr. Javed Gilani Scholarship
description: Renewable tuition award for full-time international students in an undergraduate business degree program; requires 3.0+ high school GPA

name: Academic and Cultural Sharing Scholarship (ACSS)
description: Provides resident tuition rates (~50% discount) to F-1/J-1 students maintaining 2.5 GPA; must complete two cultural sharing activities per semester

name: International Merit Scholarship
description: Merit-based scholarship for eligible international students

name: International Elite Award
description: Merit scholarship for newly admitted freshman international students with 3.0+ GPA; Kansas City area transfer award also available

name: International Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Merit scholarship for incoming international freshmen: $6,000/yr for 3.5+ GPA or $4,000/yr for 3.0-3.49 GPA; International Presidential Scholarship offers full tuition to top 6 students

name: Elbin Scholarship
description: Top merit award for international students; requires 3.75+ GPA and ACT 27+

name: LSA International Student Scholarship
description: Merit and need-based scholarship for newly admitted international students in the College of Literature Science and the Arts; renewable 2-4 years

name: Gabelli Presidential Scholars Program
description: Full-tuition merit scholarship awarded annually to 18 incoming freshmen; international students explicitly eligible

name: Merit Scholarships
description: International students eligible for most Wake Forest merit awards including full-cost Carswell Gordon Reynolds and Stamps Scholarships; no separate application required

name: International Student Merit Scholarships
description: Partial merit scholarships available to international students; limited and competitive

name: Merit-Based Scholarships
description: International undergraduates may apply for merit scholarships after admission; reviewed throughout admissions cycle; typically one-time awards

name: Merit Scholarships
description: International students eligible; range $5,000 to full tuition; no separate application required (holistic admissions review)

name: SCU Dean's Scholarship
description: Merit scholarship for which international first-year students are eligible for consideration; other merit awards restricted to U.S. citizens

name: Academic Merit Scholarships
description: All applicants regardless of citizenship automatically considered for merit scholarships at admission; no separate application required

name: Michigan Business Challenge
description: Annual campuswide business plan and pitch competition hosted by the Zell Lurie Institute for Entrepreneurship at Ross; multi-round with up to $200,000 in prizes

name: Strakosch Venture Competition / Start@Shea
description: Annual business plan competition ($10,000 first place) and startup competition ($10,000 equity-free); hosted by the Edmund H. Shea Jr. Center for Entrepreneurship

name: Elevator Competition / Deac Tank
description: Annual pitch competitions hosted by the Wake Forest Center for Entrepreneurship; cash prizes

name: BizPitch Competition
description: Annual business pitch competition led by the Perricelli-Gegnas Center for Entrepreneurship and Innovation; cash prizes for student entrepreneurs

name: Villanova Student Entrepreneurship Competition
description: Semester-long interdisciplinary pitch competition hosted by the Institute for Innovation and Entrepreneurship; Pitch Day finale with $10,000 top prize

name: StartUp Lehigh Valley Pitch Competition
description: Annual Shark Tank-style pitch competition sponsored by Lehigh University; open to all entrepreneurs; $20,000 grand prize

name: Business Pitch Competition
description: Annual pitch competition hosted by the Ciocca Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship; 3-minute pitches to investor panel for cash prizes

name: Big iDeas Business Plan Competition
description: Annual pitch competition for SMU undergraduates; 4-minute pitch for up to $5,000 in startup funds; separate 90-second pitch contest for up to $1,000

name: Galant Challenge
description: Annual pitch and venture funding event hosted by the Galant Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship at McIntire School of Commerce; open to UVA community founders

name: PNW Big Sell
description: Annual pitch competition hosted by PNW College of Business; open to students and community entrepreneurs; $10,000 first / $3,000 second / $1,000 third

name: NOVA Entrepreneur Center
description: Hub for innovation and small business development in southern Middle Tennessee; offers workshops mentorship and business development support
